demand_retry_attempt.reading: a quota on this account, reached after 812 successful readings in one day
demand_retry_attempt.why_stopped: at four retries and exponential backoff per row, confirming a quota over 466 rows costs about two hours of calls to an API already saying no
demand_retry_attempt.consequence: those rows keep demand_state=unreadable. The keyword may well have demand; what is known is that the instrument would not say. Writing zero there would destroy the only evidence that the reading is missing.

bing_get_keyword.items_returned_note: readings the instrument actually gave. The refusals in probe_states are counted as probes, never as returned items - a file that insists a refusal is not a reading may not count refusals among its readings.

refilter_pass.accumulates: movement counts ACCUMULATE across passes. They were overwritten once, and a second, empty pass erased the record of the first - a pass that reports only its own run cannot describe the file it produced.
refilter_pass.why: a rule added late is applied as code to every row, with the movements counted; after this pass the base is closed under its own rules
refilter_pass.note: probe counts in probe_rounds are unchanged and describe what was ASKED. A probe is not a key: terms dropped here were still used to question the sources, and what those sources returned stands on its own admission.
